_comment: A catalyst is not another block, it is a SOURCE: it turns what is around a mob's death into
sculk, and that spread lays down veins and eventually sensors and shriekers. One catalyst is the
family forever, the way one Tree Nursery is wood forever. Priced as one of several recipes it
would make Ancient Sculk a single trip; priced as the costly one, the seam stays worth returning
The cost is an ECHO SHARD, which is one per sewer and has no other use in this world. That is the
design rather than a number: a catalyst is the deep dark's living heart, and the only other thing
here that came out of the deep dark is the shard in a sump. Making one buy the other is the
closest this mod gets to a ritual.
